visual_system_craft.critique: The sphere reads as a flat, near-black void rather than a crafted 3D form: there is no visible cell grid, no multicolor life activity, and no specular highlight, rim light, or atmospheric falloff to establish curvature or material. Re-center the sphere in the canvas with balanced margins so it is not clipped and the right dead zone is resolved. Unify the panel system: align all section headers and their index numbers on a shared baseline with consistent tracking; give GRID and PALETTE their own rows with even 8px-multiple spacing; standardize the active-state treatment (one accent color, consistent border/fill) across chips, sliders, and toggles; and constrain slider fill colors to a single semantic accent (or a small curated set) instead of four unrelated hues. Fix the bottom clipping by giving the panel proper bottom padding so the pattern swatches, their labels, and the keyboard hints are fully visible. Tighten typography: pick one typeface family for the logo and UI, set a consistent label (uppercase, tracked, muted) vs. value (tabular numerals, brighter) hierarchy, and raise the contrast of the status indicator and footer caption to a legible level.
